description: Next.js 16 with a PURE Pages Router app -- no app/ directory at all. ../next-16/ is a hybrid (App Router with two pages/ routes bolted on), which is Next's incremental-adoption shape, NOT an un-migrated app: a hybrid project still emits the App Router runtime, so a Pages-only build's chunk set (pages/_app, getStaticProps/getServerSideProps payload wiring, the (req,res) API dialect, zero RSC) had never been obfuscated end to end. Dual-bundle: client (.next/static/chunks) + server (.next/server).

build.note: obfuscation runs INSIDE `next build`, via @afterpack/next's compiler.runAfterProductionCompile hook -- no postbuild script and no separate step; the build also writes .next/.afterpack-protection.json

interactions.description: The obfuscated Pages-Router client bundle hydrates; the counter increments on click.

hydration.note: server-rendered HTML must agree with the client-hydrated DOM.
